g.text: SEONGWOO CHOI / IT JOURNAL
What to check when Bluetooth earbuds connect to Windows
but produce no sound
ARTICLE GUIDE · 2026-10-23
Step 1. Check that the earbuds are the
output device
Click the sound icon on the taskbar and select
the Bluetooth earbuds under output devices.
Step 2. Remove the device and
reconnect it
If the earbuds appear in the list but do not
connect, go to Settings › Bluetooth & devices,
click More options (…) for the device, select…
Step 3. Set the audio format to
standard quality
With the earbuds connected, go to Settings ›
Bluetooth & devices › Devices, select the
device, and open “Advanced sound options.” Set…
Step 4. Check the driver and restart
the PC
In Device Manager, expand Bluetooth, right-click
the Bluetooth adapter name, which may be an
entry containing “radio,” and select Driver…
AI-assisted article guide. Read the article and linked sources for details.
